IN CONFIDENCE Page 2 of 3 # Other useful information ## Your loan balance Your loan balance is based on the details we held when we issued this statement. Your balance can change if, for example: - your employer changes any repayments they deducted from your wages - you travel overseas which may affect your eligibility for an interest free loan - we receive more information from StudyLink - an administration fee is charged. **Interest-free loans** If you've been living in New Zealand for 183 or more consecutive days, you're eligible for an interest free loan. If you're not living in New Zealand or have been out of New Zealand for 184 days or more, you won't be eligible for an interest free loan, unless you're being treated as overseas based - interest free. # How loan interest is calculated If your loan is not interest free, the current annual interest rate is 2.9%. Interest is calculated daily using this rate. Interest may be adjusted when transactions made in a previous statement period haven't been shown on your account. If you believe the interest we've charged is incorrect then you can dispute this, but you must do this within four months of the date of this statement. # Paying off your loan in full If you are paying interest on your loan and want to repay your loan in full, you have 30 days from the date of this statement to pay the current loan balance before further interest will be added. **If you don't make loan payments on time** If you do not pay on time we may charge you late payment interest on the outstanding amount each month, until you pay the overdue amount (including late payment interest) in full. The current annual late payment interest rate is 6.9%. This is reduced to 4.9% for amounts under instalment arrangement. # Having trouble paying? There are a number of options available in myIR to help you manage your repayments: - If you're earning salary or wages, you can apply for a reduced deduction rate - You can apply for relief if you cannot afford your payments - You can request an instalment arrangement for amounts you owe - If you're going overseas you can apply for a temporary repayment suspension. # Overseas-based enquiries If you are paying interest because you are not in New Zealand and you have any questions, call one of the following: - Toll free New Zealand 0800 600 012 - Toll free Australia 1800 559 653 - Toll free UK 0808 234 0098 - Worldwide +64 4 916 7114 Available NZT 6.15am to 8.00pm weekdays myIR You can manage your tax and entitlements online with a myIR account. In myIR you can: - keep up-to-date with your student loan - check and update your Working for Families Tax Credit details - review your KiwiSaver contributions - manage your child support payments - file returns - update your contact and bank account details. myIR is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Find out more, and register, at **www.ird.govt.nz/myIR** Our website Go to **ird.govt.nz/studentloans** to find information about repaying and managing your loan, travelling or living overseas, and your rights and responsibility.
